$description: Last Bench design tokens — source of truth is the official brand kit in assets/branding/. theme.config.js mirrors the color tokens for the app.

brand.name: Last Bench
brand.slogan: From Last Bench. To The World.
brand.logoConcept: Bench (where every journey begins) + rising arrow (the future we build together)

brandGreen.usage: Primary actions, highlights, the word being emphasized in headlines

warmWhite.usage: Light backgrounds — never pure white for page grounds

sageGreen.usage: Tinted panels, borders, soft fills behind icons

softGray.usage: Muted text on dark, disabled states

display.usage: Headlines and display copy. Set major headlines in all-caps with tight leading; emphasize one phrase in Brand Green.

voice.pattern: Short declarative pairs, full stops as beats: 'From Last Bench. To The World.' / 'Your grades don't define your benchmark. The future you build does.'
voice.emphasis: One phrase per headline turns Brand Green; the rest stays Charcoal.

iconography.style: Thin-line icons, 1.5px stroke, rounded joins, drawn in Charcoal or Brand Green

motifs.dottedWorldMap: Halftone-dot world map in light gray with green route arcs and location dots
motifs.topographicLines: Faint contour-line texture on dark and light panels
motifs.brushStroke: Black/green brush stroke divider between light content and dark footer panels
motifs.arrowMark: The rising arrow from the logo reused as a standalone accent
